review.headline: Tempo session executed to target: 4 km at 4:37/km on the nail, with easy warm-up and cool-down.
observations: Tempo block (2.0 to 6.0 km) ran 1108 s at 4:37/km, matching the 4:37 threshold target; the km splits held 4:36 to 4:37 throughout.
Tempo HR was steady at 161 to 162 bpm, with max HR 165, which is consistent with a controlled threshold effort.
Warm-up and cool-down both ran 5:45/km at about 135 to 140 bpm, inside the easy band of 5:11 to 6:13 and not drifting into tempo effort.
Full 8.0 km in 2488 s, average 5:11/km, average cadence 176 spm, and average HR 148.
flags: No RPE or athlete note was logged, so the perceived effort of this session is unknown.
No runs were logged after this session through 2026-11-25, and week 1 is at 8.0 of 42 planned km, so the plan is far behind.
CTL fell from 43.7 to 25.7 over the period, with a 7-day change of -4.7, so fitness is decaying quickly.
